name: Wavelength
description: Point-of-care ultrasound education for emergency and acute clinicians: consultant-led hands-on courses, free Wavelength Pearls and Wavelength Academy e-learning. Mapped to the RCEM curriculum, taught by FAMUS-accredited instructors and RCEM-approved ultrasound supervisors.

director.name: Dr Firas Abou-Auda
director.title: Consultant in Emergency Medicine
bio: Firas is a Consultant in Emergency Medicine and the Ultrasound Lead at Darent Valley Hospital in Kent. He has scanned in emergency care for {scanYears} years, since 2008, and has run ultrasound courses for {teachYears} years, since 2010. He is a FAMUS instructor and supervises clinicians through the FAMUS accreditation pathway.

He sits on the EUSEM Ultrasound Committee and the Emergency Ultrasound Curriculum Task Force, and he examines for and writes content for the European Board Examination in Emergency Medicine. He is an ALS and ATLS instructor.

team.name: Dr Zahra Habibzadeh
team.title: Emergency Medicine Specialist
bio: Zahra is an emergency medicine specialist and an experienced ultrasonographer, with years of hands-on scanning in acute and emergency care.
As General Manager she runs Wavelength day to day, from course planning and venues to bookings and delegate support, and brings a sonographer's eye for image quality to every course.

items.name: Darmiga T.
items.text: Excellent course, well organised, informative and relevant. Multiple opportunities to practice USS skills under direct supervision with helpful and targeted feedback. Has significantly improved my confidence performing practical procedures. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to improve their USS skills.
